officialDescription.name: Demolitionist
officialDescription.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

reloadSemantics: On accepted grenade activation refill only available magazine space from existing reserves; no ammunition is created. Capacity/reserve arithmetic is the local conservation interpretation of the official description.

reloadCooldownScope.policy: Master must explicitly label any owner-wide or per-instance choice as a local policy, not source-proven.

numericSource.retrieval: Pinned URL-bound search result, not successful direct HTTP body
numericSource.summary: 10 percent baseline per qualifying weapon kill; sniper, shotgun, glaive and fusion rifle exception 20 percent; grenade activation refills magazine and has a 3-second refill cooldown.
numericSource.specialAmmoPolicy: Not all Special-ammo weapons get 20 percent. Selected trace Retraced Path and GL Salvager's Salvo use the general 10-percent baseline; selected shotgun/glaive use 20 percent.

historicalAndCurrentQualifiers.summary: Update 7.3.0 introduced passive-cooldown-tier scaling of percentage chunk energy; slowest grenades receive half the baseline. This is not a present-day complete ability/stat formula.
Armor 3.0 preview additionally ties chunk and recharge gains to stat investment; 70 stat matched then-live gains. No current curve is inferred from this historical preview.
Explains ability-specific penalties and Vortex as historical 0.5 scalar example, but now explicitly warns portions are outdated; not adopted as current per-Hunter numeric data.
Fetched README says severely outdated and instructs not to use; update.json schema 1.9. No scalar data was adopted.

limitations: All fractions/percentages are BASE perk chunks, not exact current final received energy.
Ability tier and Armor 3.0 grenade-stat scaling are not encoded; never infer scalars from authored Minecraft cooldowns.
A local flat percent of the existing Minecraft cooldown is a staged adaptation, not measured live Destiny 2 energy.
The 3-second reload-effect cooldown is supported, but owner-wide versus per-weapon/per-instance scope is not proven by these sources.
The selected weapon must actually have the base trait selected; pool availability is not a default-equipped claim.
Salvo proves a fixed curated selectable option, not its initial equipped perk and not a randomized pool.
Manifest and secondary research snapshot may lag current live balance; no enhanced perk is supported.
Glaive melee is not assumed to be a qualifying weapon final blow. Projectile kills are the verified intended integration scope; current melee-specific numeric behavior remains unverified.
